goal: Make the Studio Projects inbox table fast to sort, filter, and search as the project list grows.
operator_request: Add click-sortable columns, quick status filters, blocker/Dave-needed filters, and boolean search across any project field.
requirements: Each visible Project Inbox column is sortable by click.
Sort direction is visible and repeat-click toggles ascending/descending.
Top filter controls include All, Finished, In Process, Queued, Blockers, and Dave Needed.
Search can inspect any visible row field: title, status, owner, progress, blocker, next action, Dave flag, work state, and project type.
Boolean search should support simple AND/OR/quoted phrase if practical; first implementation may use multi-term contains-all search with follow-up noted.
No static descriptive filler text; controls plus results only.

mim: Create interaction spec from Dave's request.
Confirm project is queued and visible in Studio Projects.
Track acceptance criteria and validation evidence.
tod: Validate sorting/filtering/search against current project rows.
codex: Escalate only if TOD stalls, implementation breaks the Studio page, or validation fails repeatedly.

acceptance_criteria: Clicking each column header sorts rows correctly.
Quick filters return expected groups for finished, working, queued, blockers, Dave-needed, and all.
Search works across all listed fields.
No new static explanatory text is added to the page.
completion_evidence: Projects table renders click-sortable headers with visible direction state.
Projects table renders quick filters for All, Finished, In Process, Queued, Blockers, and Dave Needed.
Projects table renders a search input that searches row data and supports quoted phrases plus OR groups.
Reconciliation rules now mark this project completed at 100% and no longer keep it at working/25%.
follow_up: Monitor live table behavior and reopen only if browser-level sorting, filtering, search, or row opening fails.
Use this as a pattern for small projects: one driving task, evidence, completion, then stop tracking as active work.
